newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee closes down in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee closes down in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.04 down at 41.32 to the dollar in the kerb market on Friday amid high demand for the U.S. currency, dealers said.
"The dollar demand was higher than its supply as people fear the rupee will shed more value in coming months," a dealer said. "The rupee will remain under pressure in coming days."
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate remained unchanged at 40.3300/40.5317 to the dollar set on May 6.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates ended at 2.35 percent compared to 2.30 percent on Thursday.
